nodes.label: Geocentric planetary model
nodes.summary: Historical Earth-centered planetary models fail as general physical descriptions of planetary motion and have been superseded by heliocentric and celestial-mechanical models.

nodes.label: Phlogiston theory

nodes.label: Miasma disease theory
nodes.summary: Historical theory attributing many diseases to harmful bad air; superseded for infectious disease causation by germ theory and modern epidemiology.

nodes.label: Miasma-based disease control
